item.tib: gsang sngags kyi bslab pa'i sdom tshig dang 'brel ba'i bshags sdom rig pa'i chu rgyun
item.coloph: ces gsang sngags kyi bslab ba'i sdom tshig dang 'brel ba'i bshags sdom gyi tshul 'di ni a mdo nas byung ba'i sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa nges don bstan 'dzin bzhed ngor/ sngags rigs kyi btsun pa dbra ston rig 'dzin 'chi med rnam rgyal dbang pos dbal ri gnam lcags yang rdzong gi sgrub sde dam par sbyar ba gsang chen lam la zhugs pa'i gnyen du gyur cig/
